Запуск з нуля: venv → `pip install -r requirements.txt` → `python -m playwright install chromium` → `python -m pytest`.
Підхід — кілька речень: що на API, що в UI, дані й прибирання, стабільність, звіти.

model.about:
# Toolshop test automation (Python)

![Tests](https://github.com/<your-login>/toolshop-tests/actions/workflows/tests.yml/badge.svg)

Automated UI and API tests for the Toolshop demo shop (practicesoftwaretesting.com). Stack: Python 3.13, pytest, Playwright for Python, requests, pydantic, GitHub Actions. 18 UI tests (search, product page, cart, checkout, account) and 9 API tests (products, categories, login, cart). The docs folder also contains my test documentation for Gadgetly Returns & refunds from the QA course final project: test plan, checklist, decision table, test case and bug reports.
model.run:
Requirements: Python 3.13.

python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\activate            # macOS/Linux: source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m playwright install chromium
python -m pytest                   # everything
python -m pytest -m api            # API only (no browser)
python -m pytest -m smoke --headed # smoke, watch the browser

Reports: python -m pytest --junitxml=reports/junit.xml --html=reports/report.html --self-contained-html
model.structure:
pages/        page objects (SearchPage, ProductPage, CartPage, CheckoutPage)
api/          a small client for the Toolshop REST API
models/       pydantic models of API responses
data/         test data builders (unique emails, addresses)
tests/ui/     browser tests
tests/api/    API tests
conftest.py   fixtures: settings, api client, page objects, signed-in page
docs/         test documentation (incl. Gadgetly Returns from the course)
pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, .github/workflows/tests.yml
model.approach: Data rules and contracts are checked through the API: fast, precise, parametrized (catalog filters, login errors, cart totals), with pydantic models for the responses. The UI covers what a customer sees: search and filters, product details, adding to the cart, checkout steps. Tests are independent: each creates its own data through the API (fixtures with yield clean it up), signs in without the form where possible, uses role and label locators and web-first expect assertions — no sleeps. Settings come from environment variables. CI runs on every push and PR and nightly; JUnit XML, an HTML report and traces of failed tests are uploaded as artifacts even when the run is red.
